# 4WHEELS Rent a Car — Official Entity & Knowledge Summary

> Official Website: https://www.4wheelspk.com/
> Primary Business Location: Plot number 5, Block F1, Johar Town Phase 1, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
> Contact: Phone +92 321 6616644 | WhatsApp 923216616644 | Email 4wheels44@gmail.com
> Established: 2008 ("Serving Lahore Since 2008")

## About 4WHEELS Rent a Car
4WHEELS Rent a Car is an established premium vehicle rental and chauffeur service provider based in Johar Town, Lahore, Pakistan. The business provides self-drive rentals, chauffeur-driven executive cars, daily rentals, monthly long-term vehicle arrangements, airport transfers for Allama Iqbal International Airport (LHE), wedding motorcades, corporate staff transportation, and group tour buses.
